description: OpenStreetMap Medical Facilities for North America is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This feature layer provides access to OpenStreetMap (OSM) point data of medical facilities for North America, which is updated every 15 minutes with the latest edits. Coverage: the United States. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Health. Its keywords are medical facilities. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (https://www.opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
